description: The company's own UI components, indexed from the Storybook stories in its frontend repo: which have a story (and can be shown rendered), categories, coverage, and the commit scanned. With `component`: one in full (its stories, props, where it is used, what it is built from, what it needs to render). With `component` + `story_id` + `open`: a signed link (30 minutes, members only) to the rendered story (`open: story`, the bare canvas) or Storybook's own UI (`open: storybook`), for the person to open in a browser. Build design asks from these components with sketch_ui. Nothing is spent.

category.description: a category key (the list gives them)

company.description: the company id (list_companies); not needed when you have one company, asked for otherwise

component.description: a component id (from the list) to read in full

open.description: make a signed link: story (the rendered canvas) or storybook (the full Storybook UI)

query.description: find components by name or path

repo.description: the repo id, or its full name (owner/repo); the company's main frontend repo when left out

story_id.description: with `open`: a Storybook story id, e.g. billing-plancard--default

theme.description: with `open`: the theme the story renders in (light by default)

name: component_catalog
title: The company's components
